factor_output_rule: each successful-code terminal is sqrt(selector weight) times its retained probe vector, clock/purifier matrix, and every other field factor at its elapsed cycle; multiply exact native record factors. Ideal zero raw/padding blocks remain zero; nonzero computed export-failure quantum outputs are bounded flagged blocks, not explicitly retained vectors

full_carrier_binary_support_derivation.reason: Each retained singleton effect has positive coefficient and rank1. For k>1 its scalar KL compression must vanish, which excludes its double-occupation basis vector.

C.singleton_raw_records: coin0/raw2 isolates double_b; coin1/raw1 isolates double_a

E.singleton_raw_records: either coin: raw1/contrast+2 isolates double_a; raw2/contrast-2 isolates double_b

native_exact_capacity_certificate.same66_recovery: Inverse endpoint swap followed by six disjoint matching-block Householder reflections; no additional quantum carrier in this algebraic extension.
native_exact_capacity_certificate.source_compilation_extension: The independently compiled permutation/preparation recovery uses the existing full512 source register and may use padding during intermediate controls; no fresh quantum ancilla is added per recovery.
native_exact_capacity_certificate.upper_bound_scope: An arbitrary fixed code on the full78 total-two carrier precedes state-independent selection with positive probability for every native seam; the seam, coin and C/E value are retained. For dimension greater than one, binary66 support is forced by the singleton effects. Each branch is corrected before the next attempt. Seam-dependent re-encoding before the native measurement is a different contract.
native_exact_capacity_certificate.lower_bound_scope: Six explicit matching superpositions with full source-word active recovery; coherent controls, code load/export and initialization remain specified services.
